name: Compute summed cortexmap data for group analysis
summary: Sums cortexmap surface measures across subjects on a common standard mesh with Connectome Workbench, averaging the surfaces and building a thresholded group parcellation, for group analysis.
description: Same procedure as the average App, except func metrics are summed rather than averaged across subjects (useful e.g. for counting overlapping endpoint maps); surfaces and shape files are still averaged and labels merged into a thresholded, dilated group parcellation. Every input must contain every func file of the first input, and all inputs must be on the same standard mesh.

inputs.description: cortexmaps of several subjects resampled to the same standard mesh (e.g. with the resample App); the first input defines which files are processed.
inputs.requirements: At least two cortexmaps with identical vertex counts and file names; the code always reads the first two inputs. Every func file of the first input must exist in all other inputs.

outputs.description: Group cortexmap with summed func metrics, averaged surfaces and a group parcellation (*.group.label.gii).

parameters.description: Probability threshold applied to the merged subject labels: a vertex keeps a parcel label in the group parcellation only where the fraction of subjects with that label exceeds this value.
Distance used by wb_command -metric-dilate (nearest) to fill vertices left unlabeled in the group parcellation after thresholding.
